description:
The claims of a `cognito_jwt` access token the API relies on. Not a request or
response body: it documents (and, through the generated zod schema, lets the provider
and consumers validate) what a usable token carries. The platform's pre-token trigger
adds the custom claims; standard Cognito claims (`iss`, `exp`, `token_use`, ...) are
verified by the gateway and omitted here.

sub.description: The user's stable Cognito identifier; scopes every resource to its owner.

custom:tenant_id.description: The user's tenant; every query is scoped to it. Sourced from the user's `custom:tenant_id` attribute.

roles.description:
The user's Cognito group names as a JSON-encoded array of strings (encoded so names
with separators survive the authorizer's flattening). `admin` grants cross-user
operations. Absent when the user is in no group.

cognito:groups.description: The raw Cognito group claim, when the pool includes it; equivalent to `roles`.
